description: We are a student team building an interactive space station and habitat simulation for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are looking for passionate teammates who are interested in coding, web development, or space exploration to join us!
summary: Orbit Commander is an interactive browser-based space outpost simulator designed for kids aged 7–12. Players take command of a Moon or Mars habitat, balancing limited electrical power across oxygen generation, water recycling, and hydroponic plant lights while clearing solar panel dust and running scientific experiments.   To address the challenge using real space science, Orbit Commander integrates authentic NASA datasets—including real solar flare records from NASA DONKI, spaceflight biological health research from NASA OSDR, and surface radiation measurements from the Curiosity rover and Chang'e 4. When solar storms strike, players must quickly shelter their crew and manage power trade-offs as a built-in mission-control voice explains each scientific concept in plain language.   Built as a self-contained HTML5 application that works offline and generates a printable PDF mission certificate, Orbit Commander makes complex aerospace engineering, space weather, and planetary survival accessible, engaging, and fun for young learners.
